_readme: The corpus roles (tests_corpus/corpus.py). Committed files name only Example / ExampleSA, the projects AVEVA ships and our Fx names.
A tool or test that can also use a page of a project this machine has besides the shipped ones names a role; tests_corpus/local.json (git-ignored) maps each role to this machine's value.
local.json is a flat object: {"sweep_pages": ["<Project>/<Page>.ctg"], ...}. A role that is not set is left out (its tests skip).
A role ending in _project is a project folder, _page / _library a file 'Project/File.ctg' and _pages a list of them, relative to the install's User folder.
Each entry below gives the role's meaning and the shape of its value (an illustration with Example names, not a value to use).

bench_page.meaning: tools/sim_scene_bench.py: the big page it times when no page is given (else the biggest page of a project that is not shipped).

ctedit_compare_pages.meaning: tools/live/ctedit_compare.py: pages compared with CtDraw, besides Example Mixer and ExampleSA Mixing_L3.

invalid_forms.meaning: The genie form files CtDraw cannot use either (lower case file name -> the genies whose form is invalid, when pinned).

session_soak_groups.meaning: tools/session_soak.py: group name -> pages opened together (pages sharing libraries).

sweep_pages.meaning: tools/genie_recompose_sweep.py: pages always swept, besides the shipped ones.

soak_page.meaning: A page for the Simulate start up soak's 'local' case (tools/sim_startup_soak.py).

soak_away_page.meaning: Another page of soak_page's project (the soak's away page).
